package: @astryxdesign/lab

# ChatVirtualizer

windowed msg list; rows near viewport + 2 spacers => viewport-sized DOM for 1000s of msgs; rows in document flow; during a finger scroll corrections go to spacer height not scrollTop (nothing moves under the finger, settled when the scroll ends), otherwise scrollTop; follows newest by default, re-engages within endThreshold of bottom; own scroller or attach to caller (scrollElement)

**Import:** `import {ChatVirtualizer} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `readonly T[]` | - | rows oldest-first; REFERENCE change detection — replace, never mutate **(required)** |
| `getRowKey` | `(item: T, index: number) => string` | - | stable id per row; keys the size cache + running averages — never index-derived **(required)** |
| `renderItem` | `(info: {item: T; index: number}) => ReactNode` | - | renders one row; spacing MUST be padding inside the row, not container gap/margin **(required)** |
| `estimatedItemSize` | `number \| ((item: T, index: number) => number)` | `120` | height for unmeasured rows (fn = authoritative); bias LOW — too large shrinks the range and the browser clamps you |
| `handleRef` | `Ref<ChatVirtualizerHandle>` | - | scrollToDistanceFromBottomPx + anchorToKey; both DECLARE a frame, restored as rows measure in |
| `getItemType` | `(item: T, index: number) => string` | - | per-type running averages; keeps tool stubs from blending with long markdown |
| `scrollElement` | `HTMLElement \| null` | - | attach mode: caller's scroller, rows render in one content block; pass the ELEMENT not a ref (parent ref attaches after child layout effects + ref writes are invisible to React) — read it in a passive effect, hold it in state; null (not undefined) while pending, else one commit mounts every row |
| `endThreshold` | `number` | `24` | px from bottom for a user scroll to re-engage follow; too tight = silent unfollow |
| `overscanTop` | `number` | `1600` | px of rows mounted above the viewport |
| `overscanBottom` | `number` | `600` | px of rows mounted below the viewport |
| `label` | `string` | `'Messages' (translated)` | name of the created scroller (keyboard-focusable group); default 'Messages'; own-container mode only |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | - | on the created scroller; own-container mode only |
| `className` | `string` | - | on the created scroller; own-container mode only |
